findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored and used.
findings.citation_text:
7-202.12(A) Conditions of Use. POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS shall be: (A) Used according to: (1) LAW and this Code, (2) Manufacturer's use directions included in labeling.

The spray bottles used for lactic acid sanitizer were observed at extremely high concentrations on both the inspector’s and facility’s test strips. It appeared that the dispenser is producing the concentration at the high level. The PIC is instructed to contact their chemical company (EcoLab) and have the equipment adjusted to safe use levels for food contact surfaces prior to the follow up. In the short term bottles were made and manually diluted with water to safe levels. This is a temporary measure and the machine still needs adjusting.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control.
findings.citation_text:
4-301.11 Cooling, Heating, and Holding Capacities. EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures as specified under Chapter 3. 

The top shelf of the island cooler on the east side would not register correct temperatures for the TCS foods observed. Internal temperatures were observed around 50F for multiple items on the top shelf on this side. Maintenance had stated on the work order generated during the previous routine inspection that the cooler was functioning correctly when they checked it. The Coach showed a screen shot of a computer from them and it was showing 32F in the cooler. Education was conducted and the PIC took the shelf out of service until maintenance could be contacted and arrive again. A follow up is being scheduled for 10 days to ensure compliance is attained. Ensure that all coolers are functioning correctly at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.citation_text:
3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less. 

1) Pre-cooked ravioli in the top shelf of the island cooler at the northern end are observed with internal temperatures ranging from 48F-51F. Investigating the situation lead to the conclusion that the noted items were stocked to far out from the cooling location in the unit to be effective. Items behind the second row in from the outside appear to be holding temperature correctly. The items from that point in were allowed to be kept while those from outside of the point were discarded to correct the immediate violation. Education should be conducted with the stockers to ensure that the coolers are not overloaded and the food temperatures maintained at safe ranges. 2) TCS foods on the top shelf of the island cooler on the east side are observed with internal temperatures ranging from 47F-48F. The observed items and the rest of the shelf were discarded to correct the immediate violation. The cooler issue is being managed on the line item #33 of this report.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.citation_text:
4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

This facility has begun to use a lactic acid based sanitizer. The facility has not acquired test strips for this chemical by the time of the inspection. Education was conducted and the PIC instructed to acquire test strips prior to the follow up in 10 days. Ensure that all sanitizers used for wiping food contact surfaces have appropriate test strips at all times in the facility.
